name: MrScraper
one_liner: AI-driven web scraping API that returns structured data from web pages, with a hosted scraping browser.
auth_notes: API token sent in the x-api-token header. The vendor blog also shows the token as a query parameter on the scraping browser WebSocket URL.
access_notes: Free API token from mrscraper.com per the vendor blog, which describes a free tier. Free-tier limits and paid pricing are not verified from the fetched pages, and some blog text is truncated.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve token and a REST overview exist, but the endpoint reference, auth detail page, and pricing were not fetched. The blog code samples are the only endpoint detail.
